Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Both a line cook and a scientist had their bags searched at the airport. A drug-sniffing dog had signalled that officers should look into the bag of the line cook and, sure enough, they found quite a bit of cocaine. After the scientist's bag was flagged and searched, though, they were let go as it was apparently just a false alarm. Who had drugs on them?
A. The line cook
B. The scientist
C. Not enough information
